name: Vikings
description: The adventures of Ragnar Lothbrok, the greatest hero of his age. The series tells the sagas of Ragnar's band of Viking brothers and his family, as he rises to become King of the Viking tribes. As well as being a fearless warrior, Ragnar embodies the Norse traditions of devotion to the gods. Legend has it that he was a direct descendant of Odin, the god of war and warriors.

videos.overview: History provides a first look at the their new scripted series, Vikings.

videos.overview: The inner turmoil of a man destined to choose between two gods, and the two very different lives he lives.

Bringing the Invisible People to Life: The Sami
Axe Throwing with Alexander Ludwig

The King and the Warrior Bishop
The Saga of Floki
videos.overview: After leaving Kattegat, Ivar the Boneless embarks on a journey to unknown places, where he stumbles upon a stranger and suddenly remembers previous memories, which forces him to recall the story of the unique genius that is Floki.

videos.title: The Saga of the Vikings
videos.overview: After Bjorn is gravely injured in a battle, he reunites with his brothers Ivar and Hvitserk for a strange gathering; as they share tales of their people's exploits and prophecies of Ragnarok, it becomes clear that this is not a simple reunion.

videos.overview: Kathryn Winnick Answers your Questions!

videos.title: The Saga of Bjorn
videos.overview:
This episode is a set of scenes originating from the beginning of Season 1 to the middle of Season 5 telling the brief history of Bjorn and a few other key characters, such as Ragnar, Rollo, and Lagertha.

On the run after being defeated by Ivar the Boneless in Kattegat, Torvi tells her son Hali the story of his legendary father, Viking warrior and explorer Bjorn Ironside, to ensure their family legacy lives on.

videos.title: Rites of Passage
videos.overview: Farmer, family man and rebel Ragnar Lothbrok is determined to sail west to discover new lands and riches despite an intimidating warning from his village's tyrannical leader, Lord Haraldson, who makes it clear in no uncertain terms that doing so could result in severe consequences.

videos.title: Wrath of the Northmen
videos.overview: The journey west begins as Ragnar gathers a crew willing to risk their lives to travel into the unknown. Earl Haraldson's paranoia reaches new heights as his fear of Ragnar's success grows.

videos.title: Dispossessed
videos.overview: Ragnar and his crew return from their trip with treasure, and Earl Haraldson has no choice but to sanction another raid. The west is open for the taking, and the Vikings' world will never be the same.

videos.title: Trial
videos.overview: Ragnar and his crew sail out with Earl Haraldson's permission.

videos.title: Raid
videos.overview: A seer reads Earl Haraldson's future and tells him that Ragnar searches for his death.

videos.title: Burial of the Dead
videos.overview: Ragnar, weak and still hurt, must meet the Earl head-on after it comes to light that Rollo has been tortured on Haraldson’s orders. The two men will come together face to face with a single outcome possible: Only one man will leave this fight alive.

videos.title: A King's Ransom
videos.overview: Three Viking ships sail toward the Royal Villa of King Aelle in eastern England. Ragnar wants ransom in exchange for peace, but the king has a very different plan in mind.

videos.title: Sacrifice
videos.overview: The traditional pilgrimage to Uppsala to thank the gods brings a torrent of emotions for Ragnar, Lagertha, and Athelstan. Ragnar, pulling farther away from his wife goes to make peace with the death of his unborn son. Lagertha, still reeling from her miscarriage, wants to find out from the gods if more sons are in her future. As the Vikings come together to sacrifice and give thanks to their gods, Athelstan discovers just how strong his Christian faith still is.

videos.title: All Change
videos.overview: Ragnar travels to Götaland to help King Horik resolve a land dispute with the area's leader, Jarl Borg. Meanwhile, sickness infects the village of Kattegat, and the people look to Lagertha to help them appease the gods.

videos.title: Brother's War
videos.overview: The battle begins between Ragnar and King Horik's forces against Jarl Borg; Princess Aslaug makes her way to Kattegat.

videos.title: Invasion
videos.overview: The time has come for an unlikely alliance to band together for a new raid on England; a storm pushes the Viking fleet to a new destination; Ragnar and his men may have met their match.

videos.title: Treachery
videos.overview: King Ecbert finds himself facing an entirely new kind of foe; Ragnar races to dominate in the west; Jarl Borg has his own plans in store for the future of Kattegat.

videos.title: Eye for an Eye
videos.overview: Ragnar and Ecbert come face to face; Jarl Borg rules Kattegat with an iron fist; Rollo must now become the leader his people need in Ragnar's absence.

videos.title: Answers in Blood
videos.overview: Lagertha and Ragnar unite to try to win Kattegat back from Jarl Borg; Aslaug must face the truth of her prophecies; Athelstan struggles to define his faith; Bjorn must once again make a choice.

videos.title: Unforgiven
videos.overview: King Horik returns to Kattegat with a surprising proposition for Ragnar; Lagertha runs into a less than enthusiastic homecoming from her new husband; Athelstan becomes confidant to King Ecbert.

videos.title: Blood Eagle
videos.overview: Ragnar and King Horik clash over how to dispense justice to Jarl Borg. In Wessex, King Aelle arrives and Ecbert has an eye on a new alliance.

videos.title: Boneless
videos.overview: Princess Aslaug's latest prophecy comes to fruition as she readies to give birth once more. Ragnar, Horik and their new ally Lagertha set sail for Wessex - Ragnar and Horik have very different ideas about the true purpose of this trip.

videos.title: The Choice
videos.overview: Ragnar's warriors march on to King Ecbert's villa and are met with a surprisingly vicious welcome party.

videos.title: The Lord's Prayer
videos.overview: Ragnar and King Horik return to Kattegat; Ragnar places his trust in those who have stood by him.

videos.title: Mercenary
videos.overview: Ragnar and Lagertha's fleets depart Kattegat once more for Wessex and this time they bring a group to colonize there. King Ecbert hosts the Norsemen and proposes a deal. Despite the misgivings of some of the other leaders, Ragnar leads his forces into battle once more, but this time as allies of Wessex.

videos.title: The Wanderer
videos.overview: Lagertha and Athelstan help to set up the Viking settlement. A mysterious wanderer arrives in Kattegat.

videos.title: Warrior's Fate
videos.overview: King Ecbert visits the developing Viking settlement as the first harvest is sown.

videos.title: Scarred
videos.overview: There is bitterness in the camp, Floki is angry over the alliance with Ecbert.

videos.title: The Usurper
videos.overview: The fleet returns to Kattegat to discover tragic circumstances await.

videos.title: Born Again
videos.overview: Preparations for the Paris raid pick up speed, and Rollo thinks about the Seer's prophecy.

videos.title: Paris
videos.overview: The Viking fleet causes panic in Paris. The Emperor Charles declares he will remain in the city.

videos.title: To the Gates!
videos.overview: The Viking army sets out and Paris goes into lockdown as the army prepares the defense.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: Paris is hit with a second assault. Emperor Charles needs to make a difficult decision.

videos.title: The Dead
videos.overview: With one last chance to take Paris, Ragnar, and his Vikings troops take a daring chance. Ragnar asks Bjorn for a favor that could change the course of Viking history.

videos.title: A Good Treason
videos.overview: A dangerously ill Ragnar returns to Kattegat, where his suspected death kicks off a scramble to succeed him. Meanwhile, Lagertha engages in a power struggle with her calculating, former second in command, Kalf. Rollo betrays his heritage and remains in Frankia. Floki pays the price for his brutality against the Christian priest.

videos.title: Kill the Queen
videos.overview: As Ragnar and Floki remain at odds, Rollo makes great efforts in Paris to win over his new bride, Princess Gisla. Meanwhile, King Ecbert sets the task for his son Aethelwulf to rescue Queen Kwenthrith.

videos.title: Mercy
videos.overview: Floki learns of the heavy price he has paid for his actions. Rollo finds an unlikely ally in Count Odo. Bjorn has to fight a fierce opponent in the wilderness.

videos.title: Yol
videos.overview: King Aelle goes to Wessex for Christmas and is not impressed with how family relations are developing. Rollo's future hangs in the balance.

videos.title: Promised
videos.overview: There's an air of betrayal as those whom Odo trusts plot against him. Ecbert agrees to support Kwenthrith in Mercia. Pregnancy brings happiness to Lagertha and Kalf and a marriage is arranged.

videos.title: What Might Have Been
videos.overview: Ragnar declares another raid on Paris at the Thing in Kattegat. Ecbert also has a journey in mind as he dispatches Aethelwulf and Alfred on a pilgrimage to Rome.

videos.title: The Profit and the Loss
videos.overview: In England, King Ecbert's true ambitions are revealed as he plots to gain the crown of Mercia. The Vikings attack Paris with considerable force, but will Rollo's defenses be too much for them to overcome? Meanwhile, Harbard, the mysterious wanderer, returns and causes a stir amongst the women of Kattegat.

videos.title: Portage
videos.overview: Defeat for the Vikings calls Ragnar's leadership into question as they evacuate their camp and move back down river. Ragnar remains inscrutable until he orders the fleet to beach at a cliff face and unveils an ingenious plan. Rollo and Gisla have news that strengthens Rollo's position at the French Court.

videos.title: Death All 'Round
videos.overview: The labors of the Vikings eventually bear fruit as, within sight of Paris, they re-launch their boats but this time along with some interesting structures that Floki has built. Aethelwulf and Alfred eventually arrive in Rome and honors are conferred by Pope Leo but relations are not so cordial in Wessex between King Ecbert and the disgruntled King Aelle.

videos.title: The Last Ship
videos.overview: A ferocious battle between the Vikings and the French eventually comes down to Ragnar against Rollo. The outcome will seal the fate of the two brothers.

videos.title: The Outsider
videos.overview: Ragnar returns to Kattegat and formulates a plan to head back to Wessex, where he intends to right past wrongs.. Meanwhile, Lagertha plans a power play in Kattegat and Bjorn prepares to fulfill his long-held dream to explore the Mediterranean in a sleek new boat built for him by Floki.

videos.title: The Vision
videos.overview: The Kattegat locals chide Ragnar that the gods have deserted him as he struggles to crew his voyage to Wessex. It's Bjorn who has charisma now as he prepares to fulfill his long-held dream to explore the Mediterranean in a sleek new boat built for him by Floki. By contrast, Ragnar must accept weathered boats and a crew he has bribed but when Aslaug foresees that the fleet will be lost in a vicious storm her warnings go un-heeded by Ragnar and her precious son, Ivar.

videos.title: Two Journeys
videos.overview: Ragnar's fleet is shipwrecked and washes up on the Wessex coast, but without enough survivors to form a credible force, Ragnar and Ivar have a difficult decision to make. Rollo meets his Viking comrades again and can't resist the urge to join Bjorn's voyage, risking his marriage and his new Frankish identity. Ragnar too is taking a risk as he carries Ivar towards the Royal Villa in Wessex – throwing himself and his son upon the mercy of King Ecbert.

videos.title: In the Uncertain Hour Before the Morning
videos.overview: Ragnar's faith is tested.

videos.title: All His Angels
videos.overview: Ragnar's fate is decided.

videos.title: Crossings
videos.overview: Bjorn's fleet sails onward and launches a surprise attack. Back in Kattegat, Lagertha continues in her quest for power.

videos.title: The Great Army
videos.overview: The Viking army begins to gather in Kattegat. Lagertha must remain vigilant in the absence of her son, Bjorn.

videos.title: Revenge
videos.overview: Ragnar's plan comes to fruition. The Viking army lands on the coast of Northumbria.

videos.title: On the Eve
videos.overview: The Viking army causes panic in the English countryside as King Ecbert and Aethelwulf plan the defense of the realm.

videos.title: The Reckoning
videos.overview: Prince Aethelwulf finds himself subject to the Vikings' battle master plan. Ecbert remains behind with a plan of his own.

videos.title: The Departed (1)
videos.overview: Tensions mount between the sons of Ragnar Lothbrok as the Vikings continue to threaten the very heart of England. As the Great Army moves to take York, with King Aethelwulf and his family still in hiding, Heahmund—the warrior bishop—must rally the Saxons to defend the Realm.

videos.title: The Departed (2)
videos.overview: Tensions mount between the sons of Ragnar Lothbrok as the Vikings continue to threaten the very heart of England. As the Great Army moves to take York, with King Aethelwulf and his family still in hiding, Heahmund—the warrior bishop—must rally the Saxons to defend the Realm.

videos.title: Homeland
videos.overview: Celebrations are cut short in the aftermath of the battle at York. Ragnar Lothbrok's sons are pitted against each other as tensions reach an all-time high, and each is forced to choose a side.

videos.title: The Plan
videos.overview: Guided by Heahmund's visions, the Saxons devise a battle plan. Ivar the Boneless strategises as the Vikings undergo increasing pressure. Bjorn Ironside finds himself in a new territory and must convince the local commander he is a trader.

videos.title: The Prisoner
videos.overview: Ivar meets his match in Heahmund. Floki returns to Kattegat. Bjorn receives a lavish welcome in North Africa.

videos.title: The Message
videos.overview: Lagertha is betrayed, and Bjorn must find a way to support the distraught queen. Floki and his settlers arrive in a new land, but it is far from what they expected.

videos.title: Full Moon
videos.overview: Bjorn returns to Kattegat to learn that an attack will take place during the next full moon. Ivar must decide if he can place his trust in a former enemy on the battlefield.

videos.title: The Joke
videos.overview: The battle for Kattegat begins and, as the two armies line up to fight, the Great Heathen Army must decide between a final plea for peace or all-out war. Floki faces discord among the settlers.

videos.title: A Simple Story
videos.overview: The army leaders consider their options in the aftermath of the battle. In Floki's camp, all hopes of binding the community together are dashed as tragedy unfolds.

videos.title: Moments of Vision
videos.overview: A sense of doom looms over Kattegat as bloodshed ensues. The defeated army flees in the face of the victors. A legendary warrior makes his way home.

videos.title: The Revelation
videos.overview: Ivar is crowned the new king of Kattegat just in time to welcome Rollo home. Bjorn, Lagertha and Ubbe must rely on unsteady alliances to survive.

videos.title: Murder Most Foul
videos.overview: Bjorn, Lagertha and Ubbe face an uncertain fate as Heahmund's loyalty is tested. Floki fights to understand the will of the gods. Ivar may have met his match.

videos.title: A New God
videos.overview: Heahmund must try to convince King Alfred that his actions are in defense of the Crown. Ubbe and Torvi strengthen the position of the Vikings but not all in the Viking camp support their strategy. Another settler disappears in Iceland.

videos.title: The Lost Moment
videos.overview: As the celebrations for Ivar continue in Kattegat, grief hits Iceland and Floki must now make a fated decision. Harald's army approaches Wessex. A conspiracy grows against King Alfred.

videos.title: Hell
videos.overview: Bishop Heahmund is wracked with guilt as he fights to renounce his passions. Viking will clash with Saxon on the battlefield leaving a key figure lost in the balance.

videos.title: The Buddha
videos.overview: Bjorn achieves one of Ragnar's dreams. Ivar hatches a new plan while preparing for a divine arrival. In Iceland, a settler returns in a terrible state. King Alfred faces his greatest threat yet.

videos.title: The Most Terrible Thing
videos.overview: An unexpected turn amongst the settlers leaves Floki powerless. King Alfred confronts Judith. In York, Bjorn must strike a deal with Harald. Wessex is once again threatened by a Viking force, but who will lead the Saxon army to defend the Realm?

videos.title: Baldur
videos.overview: Hvitserk is severely tested. Floki makes an amazing discovery. Freydis gives Ivar a surprise. Ubbe negotiates with the three Danish Kings that have massed their armies in Reading, but the negotiations may have a perilous outcome.

videos.title: What Happens in the Cave
videos.overview: Ubbe is forced into hand-to-hand combat. Floki reaches new depths and is met by a shocking sight. Bjorn sets off for Scandinavia with an old rival.

videos.title: Ragnarok
videos.overview: A new battle for Kattegat is on and only the gods know who will emerge victorious.

videos.title: New Beginnings
videos.overview: It’s six months after the battle of Kattegat and Bjorn is now King. As he struggles with the responsibilities of kingship, he finds he can’t rely on his mother. Ivar falls into the hands of the Kievan Rus, and in their ruthless and unpredictable ruler, Prince Oleg, he may finally have met his match.

videos.title: The Prophet
videos.overview: Messengers arrive in Kattegat with news that presents Bjorn with a dilemma. Prince Oleg of Kiev seems untroubled by his conscience. Lagertha has settled into her new, peaceful life, but danger lurks nearby.

videos.title: Ghosts, Gods and Running Dogs
videos.overview: Lagertha is forced to take action. In Kiev, although Oleg continues to be friendly, Ivar is aware of the threat which Oleg poses to the vulnerable young heir to the throne. Bjorn has answered the call and come to the aid of an old enemy.

videos.title: All the Prisoners
videos.overview: Lagertha leads her village's response to the recent attacks, but despite her best efforts, the consequences are tragic. Olaf has a bold new plan for the future of Norway. Ivar discusses Oleg's ambitions for Scandinavia.

videos.title: The Key
videos.overview: As Norway’s Kings and Jarls arrive at Harald’s territory for the election of the King of all Norway, Olaf is certain of the result, however, it may not go as smoothly as he believes. Lagertha’s village is anxious in anticipation of another attack and she is relieved when Gunnhild arrives with re-enforcements. In Kiev, Igor and Ivar engage in subterfuge and Ivar is stunned when he encounters a ghost from his past.

videos.title: Death and the Serpent
videos.overview: Bjorn is forced to act quickly in the aftermath of the election for the king of all Norway. The Bandits attack Lagertha’s village again confident of an easy victory. However, when the defense boils down to single combat with Lagertha, victory seems less likely. In Kattegat, haunted and paranoid, Hvitserk continues to unravel.

videos.title: The Ice Maiden
videos.overview: Bjorn returns to Kattegat. Harald gains a measure of revenge on Olaf. In Kiev, interesting news reaches Ivar and Igor about Prince Dir.

videos.title: Valhalla Can Wait
videos.overview: Bjorn faces a difficult decision. Ubbe and Torvi leave Kattegat in search of new lands and perhaps old friends. Oleg's plans for the invasion of Scandinavia take shape. King Harald is baffled by the origin of a mysterious raiding party.

videos.title: Resurrection
videos.overview: In Iceland, Ubbe and Torvi finally meet a mysterious wanderer. Bjorn is forced to re-think who his enemies are when Erik returns from a scouting mission with worrying information. Bjorn will need allies, but he may not be able to convince his old foe, King Harald, to join forces in the face of the new threat. Ivar is reunited with someone close to him.

videos.title: The Best Laid Plans
videos.overview: Ivar and Igor may be plotting against Oleg, but they're still part of the force that departs Kiev to invade Scandinavia. King Harald and King Bjorn begin furious preparations for the invasion.

videos.title: King of Kings
videos.overview: In Iceland, Ubbe learns the truth about Kjetill and has a difficult decision to make. Back in Norway, the battle against the Rus has had grave consequences. But re-enforcements have arrived, and Bjorn has an idea that may yet save the day.

videos.title: All Change
videos.overview: Ubbe persuades the settlers in Iceland to embark on a voyage of exploration. The defeat of the Rus creates power vacuums in both Kattegat and Kiev.

videos.title: The Signal
videos.overview: The election for Kattegat's new ruler is held, but a surprise visitor disrupts the proceedings. Ivar puts his plan to overthrow Oleg into action.

videos.title: Lost Souls
videos.overview: As his enemies scheme for power, Harald prepares for his coronation and chooses a queen. Ubbe's party reaches shore — but not the one they're seeking.

videos.title: All at Sea
videos.overview: Factions in Greenland spill blood, driving Ubbe's company away. Troops under Ivar and Dir seize Kiev for Prince Igor. Gunnhild makes a fateful choice.

videos.title: The Final Straw
videos.overview: Ubbe and his followers languish on the open sea. Ivar and Hvitserk receive a frosty reception in Kattegat, until a restless Ivar has a revelation.

videos.title: The Raft of Medusa
videos.overview: Ivar and Hvitserk lead King Harald's army to England, where King Alfred of Wessex abandons his royal villa and marches to meet the sons of Ragnar.

videos.title: It's Only Magic
videos.overview: King Alfred falls ill as the Viking army seizes the high ground. Ingrid curses Erik. Ubbe and his people find a new world — but they're not alone.

videos.title: The Lord Giveth...
videos.overview: Ubbe and the settlers open relations with the indigenous people of the new land. Ivar's strategy lures Alfred's forces into a devastating battle.

videos.title: The Last Act
videos.overview: Ubbe reunites with an old friend but must pass judgment on a killer. The armies of Alfred and Ivar clash as each leader looks to his god for strength.

language: English, Old English, Norse, Old, Latin, French, Arabic, Greek, Ancient (to 1453), Russian
awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 46 wins & 133 nominations total
